description: ForWarn Forest Change Assessment Viewer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NASA, National Aeronautics and Space Administration; NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information; Oak Ridge National Laboratory. Forest managers and landowners can monitor forest health across the contiguous United States using satellite images taken every eight days. ForWarn's images and tools help them attribute abnormalities to insects, disease, wildfire, storms, human development, or unusual weather. Archived data provide the ability to detect disturbances across all lands since 2000. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Cold, High Winds, Landslides, Vector-Borne Disease, Wildfire. Assets: Economy, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
